name: FTG_Conserve Mode Activated
description: The FortiGate device has entered Conserve Mode, a system state triggered when memory usage exceeds a defined threshold. In this state, the system limits functionality to preserve stability, such as by stopping certain processes or bypassing UTM scanning. This alert indicates potential performance degradation and should be investigated to prevent service disruption.
